name: audio-hooks
description: Audio notifications + AI-controlled config for DipoleML, Cursor IDE, and Codex CLI events. 39 hook events across DipoleML, Cursor and Codex (30 registered on DipoleML) + 47 matcher variants, each with its own sound. Desktop toasts, TTS, webhooks, status line + per-subagent rows, rate-limit alerts. Auto-bridges to Cursor IDE 3.2.16+; native install via 'audio-hooks install --cursor' or 'audio-hooks install --codex'.
